setups.with_cache: openai_prompt_cache_key + prompt_cache_options mode=implicit + cache breakpoint after the instructions (prompt + handbook)
setups.without_cache: prompt_cache_options mode=explicit, no breakpoints, AND a new random id at the start of the instructions on every model call so no two requests share a prefix
setups.both: x-portkey-cache-force-refresh: true so Portkey's response cache never replays an old response
